beats.text: Why are leading AI teams switching to Deep Residual Learning after this 3.57% benchmark result?
beats.visual_focus: A deep network visualization showing a layer-stack collapsing under its own weight.

visual_blueprint.title: THE DEEPENING PARADOX

beats.text: The villain is the degradation problem; deeper networks struggle to represent identity mappings, effectively suffocating the signal through repeated, non-linear transformations.
beats.visual_focus: A signal waveform getting crushed and distorted as it passes through successive activation layers.

beats.text: He and colleagues bypass this by reformulating layers into residual functions, forcing the network to learn only the delta, not the entirety.
beats.visual_focus: A shortcut connection jumping over a weight layer to preserve the original signal.
